title: Vector clocks: causality without a global clock

messages.note: Start: A, B and C each hold a vector [a,b,c] of counters, all zero
A has a local event: it increments its own slot

messages.caption: A sends its vector to B

messages.note: Meanwhile, C has a local event of its own: it increments its own slot

messages.caption: B sends its vector to C

messages.note: Concurrent: A's event [1,0,0] and C's local event [0,0,1] - neither vector is <= the other, so neither happened before the other
Ordered: A's event [1,0,0] <= C's final vector [1,1,2] in every slot - A's event happened-before C's receive
